title: Towards real-world hdrtv reconstruction: A data synthesis-based approach
authors: Zhen Cheng, Tao Wang, Yong Li, Fenglong Song, Chang Chen, Zhiwei Xiong

details.作者: Zhen Cheng, Tao Wang, Yong Li, Fenglong Song, Chang Chen, Zhiwei Xiong
details.简介: Existing deep learning based HDRTV reconstruction methods assume one kind of tone mapping operators (TMOs) as the degradation procedure to synthesize SDRTV-HDRTV pairs for supervised training. In this paper, we argue that, although traditional TMOs exploit efficient dynamic range compression priors, they have several drawbacks on modeling the realistic degradation: information over-preservation, color bias and possible artifacts, making the trained reconstruction networks hard to generalize well to real-world cases. To solve this problem, we propose a learning-based data synthesis approach to learn the properties of real-world SDRTVs by integrating several tone mapping priors into both network structures and loss functions.
